jobs.description:
As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
 
 

• Coordinate food safety, sustainability, religious, ethical, and customer-specific certification schemes across the Group. 

• Monitor certification statuses, audit schedules, renewal timelines, and maintain accurate compliance records and databases. 

• Support the planning, administration, documentation, and follow-up of internal and external audits across production sites. 

• Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and perform trend analyses to support data-driven decision-making. 

• Track audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 

• Provide administrative and analytical support for continuous improvement projects, annual program reviews, and FSQA initiatives. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Bachelor's degree in a food-related or data-analytical field. 

• Experience in an administrative or support role within a technical, quality, or food industry environment. 

• Strong reporting and data management skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office applications. 

• Experience with databases, KPI reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools; knowledge of auditing and certification schemes is a strong asset. 

• Professional proficiency in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus. 

• A detail-oriented, analytical, and structured mindset, combined with flexibility, independence, and a positive attitude.

As a maintenance operator, you are responsible for the preventive and corrective maintenance of production machines. You detect technical faults, solve them independently or report them to your supervisor. You provide technical support to production teams and actively contribute to improvements in installations and working methods. You will also assist in the installation and commissioning of new machines.

Your tasks include:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations

• Resolving mechanical and electrical breakdowns to ensure smooth production

• Providing technical support to operators

• Assisting with new installations (setup, adjustment, parameter settings)

• Proposing improvements to maintenance procedures and technical documentation

• Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and environmental regulations

• The main focus is on mechanics (pneumatics, hydraulics, welding, bearings, compressors, heavy mechanics), with basic knowledge of electricity.

• Technical degree in electromechanics or equivalent through experience

• Initial experience in industrial maintenance is a plus, but motivated juniors are also welcome

• Strong interest in mechanical maintenance (electricity as complementary knowledge)

• Insight into industrial processes and the interaction between machines

• You work safely, accurately, and follow procedures correctly

• You are stress-resistant and can react quickly in case of breakdowns

• You communicate well and enjoy working in a team

• You speak English and French

• You are eager to learn and open to new technologies

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2

• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion

• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)

• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation

• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C++, and Python

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization

• Control systems for robotics

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics

• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)

• You can communicate fluently in English

For an automotive company in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a full-time category B Driver for the 'YARD' department. You will work in a two-shift system.

VG 458/BUOSAP

As a yard driver / Operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager - Industrial Engineering
jobs.description:
Industrial CAPEX project environment

As Project Manager, you take end-to-end responsibility for complex multidisciplinary investment projects within an industrial process setting. You manage the complete lifecycle and remain accountable for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The work includes both greenfield developments and major modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through to commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline planning in MS Project.
• Drive every project phase, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Act as the primary accountable contact for stakeholders and management during the full course of the project.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams covering mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS expertise.
• Manage scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations affecting cost or schedule.
• Report clearly on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to creating and owning project schedules, not merely following them up.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical skills with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You show strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

To support our further growth ambitions, Brantsandpatents is looking for an experienced 
(partially qualified) European Patent Attorney 
with a background in life sciences.
 

As a (partially qualified) patent attorney, you will analyze the R&D activities and innovations of your clients and develop an appropriate IP strategy based on this analysis.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients in the broad field of life sciences.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You'll work from our office in Ghent.

You have or are...
 
 

• A Patent Attorney or Partially Qualified Patent Attorney. 

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in a similar role, preferably in the private sector 

• At least a Masters' degree in life sciences. A PhD is a strong plus. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English.

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
 

Your main responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air 
 
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE) 
 
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...) 
 
• Receiving and processing customs documents 
 
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint) 
 
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests 
 
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status 
 
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum A2 diploma 

• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role 

• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes 

• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems 

• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing 

• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator 

• Able to work independently and manage priorities

Description

• Team coordination: Coordinate and supervise teams from various departments to ensure the achievement of set goals.
• Client management: Provide excellent customer service and ensure thorough follow-up on client files.
• Project management: Manage and oversee inter-departmental projects, from planning to delivery of results.
• Quality control: Monitor the quality of services provided and track performance using KPIs.
• Event management: Participate in organizing and following up on internal and external events.
• Strategic planning: Contribute to the definition and implementation of marketing strategies for various departments.
• Development and optimization: Develop tools and methods to optimize work processes and improve overall efficiency.
• Data analysis: Analyze operational performance and provide detailed reports with recommendations.
• 
Administrative management: Oversee daily administrative tasks and contribute to the improvement of internal processes.

 

Profile

• Languages: You have an excellent command of French, English, and Dutch.
• Organizational skills: Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Communication skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Strategic marketing: Solid knowledge of strategic marketing concepts.
• Leadership: Ability to lead and supervise teams.
• Adaptability: Able to work in a constantly evolving environment.
• IT skills: Proficient in project management software and common office tools.
• Team spirit: Able to collaborate with various departments.
• 
Degree: Hold a bachelor's degree, preferably related to the position.
